answer: Strongest mechanism: random grading-panel rotation each epoch. Each grader panel is drawn by verifiable random function from the pool, secret until work is committed, then revealed on-chain. Reputation flows only from unpredictable panels, so no fixed jury of colluding clones can be pre-arranged; sybils scatter. Capturing a panel requires controlling most of the pool, which needs bonded stake, and detected collusion slashes it. Attack cost moves from a bribe to a slashable dominant stake, so collusion never pays in any haven, fable, or trellis.
